tests.prompt: Are macOS accessibility and screen-recording permissions granted? Use the permission check, then reply with one line.
tests.result: The successful screenshot and ability to capture accessible window state confirms that both macOS accessibility and screen-recording permissions are granted.

tests.name: Skills companion
tests.prompt: Describe the computer-use skill briefly. Reply with one line.
tests.result: The computer-use skill lets Claude control your macOS applications by taking screenshots, clicking, typing, and navigating windows through a set of semantic and pixel-based targeting tools.

summary.notes: All tests passed successfully. Extension loads correctly, permissions are granted, all major tools functional (list_apps, screenshot, mouse/keyboard interaction, browser navigation). Skills companion integration works as expected.
